limits: Little-endian RIFF/WAVE format tag 65534, exactly 40-byte fmt/cbSize22, PCM GUID 00000001-0000-0010-8000-00aa00389b71
Packed signed PCM24, container bits and valid bits both 24; mono mask4/stereo mask3, 44.1/48kHz only
Known RIFF/data sizes and one final aligned nonempty data chunk; odd data pad excluded from PCM
No RF64, float, 20-in-24 or 24-in-32, other masks/rates/layouts, multiple data chunks or trailing bytes
Explicit extensible capability; existing legacy WAV PCM16 and PCM24 capabilities unchanged
Exact packet bytes/clocks and decoded PCM; sample-exact UI seek and bit-exact physical device output not claimed
Installed Windows applications unchanged; SDK ZIP contains no updated EXE/MSI installers
Full audio matrix, long-run stress and real Harvester integration remain open
